title: Position index
statement: For a list of segments and an index $s$, assign the left boundary the offset preceding segment $s$, and assign the right boundary that offset plus one and the selected segment's encoded length. A cell with index $c$ and marker $p$ is assigned the preceding offset plus one and its cell offset.
